recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Do not edit archived Medication examples for this issue unless a separate build-scope decision makes those Archive files active again.
issue_request: FHIR-12764 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for DSTU2 asking to remove the Medication.product backbone element and move its child elements directly under Medication, with TR/FHIR-12399 reviewed as part of that cleanup.
initial_application: Jira comments cite SVN/Git commit b0500f8b520d72851aba346483f21d1ded9a86b3 (@11055), which removed the Medication.product spreadsheet row, renamed Medication.product.form/ingredient/batch paths to direct Medication children, and fixed examples by deleting product wrappers.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Medication source has top-level Medication.doseForm and Medication.ingredient and later current package/instance/definition modeling, but no Medication.product definition/path. Active Medication examples listed by list-Medication-examples.xml do not use product wrappers. Remaining <product> wrappers are limited to unreferenced source/medication/Archive files. FHIR-12412 was retracted because the product backbone removal made a rename unnecessary.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active build inputs already implement the FHIR-12764 decision; editing archive files would not be a current-spec fix.

related_jiras.note: The seed explicitly asked to review this abstract-Medication request; its resolution did not require preserving or restoring Medication.product.
The same application commit updated Medication introduction/ingredient guidance while moving product children upward.
The separate request to rename Medication.product was withdrawn after the product backbone was deemed unnecessary.
